use_case: Use the request form during weather-impact documentation and recovery planning when the weather delay record must identify date, site, scheduled activities, contractual weather basis, crew, equipment, and affected milestones. Complete the applicable handoff for verified impact, notice status, schedule analysis, mitigation assignment, recovery plan, and claim-record linkage.
